title: SOC Investigation Copilot

blueprintSignals.name: Evidence link rate
blueprintSignals.definition: share of claims with log references
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Check that each link points at a line that really contains the indicator

blueprintSignals.name: Query success and retry count
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Log every call, failure and retry with the case id

blueprintSignals.name: Verdict agreement with senior analysts
blueprintSignals.definition: share of verdicts that match senior analysts reviewing blind
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Reviewers must not see the agent's verdict before deciding

blueprintSignals.name: Injection success rate
blueprintSignals.definition: share of poisoned cases where the agent changes its verdict or acts
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Build the attack set from real log fields and file names, and keep it out of tuning

blueprintSignals.name: Unsupported escalation rate
blueprintSignals.definition: cases escalated because evidence was missing, split by cause
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Track whether the share rises after a log pipeline change

label: For "SOC Investigation Copilot": Accelerate investigations by letting an agent gather evidence from SIEM, EDR and identity tools and propose verdicts with cited queries. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Replay set includes cases used for prompt tuning.
